Spider-Man: The Other

▸ Evolve or die! As his body begins to break down, Spider-Man turns to his friends on the Avengers for help—but when he realizes neither science nor magic can cure him, he undergoes a radical transformation that changes his relationship with his powers forever. Who will emerge from the rubble: the Man... or the Spider?
